records.body_text: I only use Instamart for late night snack runs. Never scrolled to see Instamart sells cleaning supplies and personal care.
Instamart has the best delivery but worst category browsing. I still only buy groceries on Instamart.
Instamart is great for groceries but personal care prices are high. I literally only order milk and bread from Instamart every day.
Pro tip: Instamart has pet food now! Took me 6 months of daily Instamart orders to find out.
